info.title: agentblazor
info.description: Advanced scaffold and validation tool for wiring AgentBlazor into existing Blazor apps.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze an existing Blazor app and write a read-only markdown report

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --host
options.description:
Name of the Blazor host project
(auto-detected if not specified)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Path to write the markdown report. Defaults
to .agentblazor/analysis.md next to the
solution or project

options.name: --framework
options.description:
Framework override. v1 currently supports
'auto' and 'blazor'

options.name: --no-readiness
options.description:
Skip AgentBlazor install-readiness checks in
the report

options.name: --static-only
options.description:
Skip the LLM workflow suggestion call and
write a static-analysis-only report
project plus project references; 'solution'
scans every project in the solution

options.name: --scan-scope
options.description:
Projects to scan: 'references' scans the host
project plus project references; 'solution'
scans every project in the solution

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Skip interactive prompts and use defaults

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Inspect an existing Blazor app for baseline AgentBlazor wiring

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --host
options.description:
Name of the Blazor host project (auto-detected if
not specified)

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Skip interactive prompts and use defaults

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to solution (.sln/.slnx) or project (.csproj) file

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Initialize AgentBlazor for an existing Blazor app and show the next installer
steps

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --host
options.description:
Name of the Blazor host project
(auto-detected if not specified)

options.name: --description
options.description: Short description of the application

options.name: --agent-goals
options.description:
Comma- or semicolon-separated workflows
the app agent should help users
accomplish

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Skip interactive prompts and use defaults

options.name: --save-config
options.description:
Save settings to .agentblazorc config
file

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to solution (.sln/.slnx) or project (.csproj) file

commands.name: scaffold
commands.description: Preview baseline AgentBlazor install edits or V2 workflow onboarding artifacts

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --host
options.description:
Name of the Blazor host project
(auto-detected if not specified)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Preview the proposed edits without
mutating any files

options.name: --approve
options.description: agentblazor scaffold workflows ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp

options.name: --diff
options.description: agentblazor scaffold ./MySolution.slnx --host MyBlazorApp --provider openai

options.name: --use-local-source
options.description:
Use local AgentBlazor source projects
instead of the AgentBlazor package
reference

options.name: --provider
options.description:
Scaffold provider registration: openai,
azure-openai, or ollama

options.name: --description
options.description:
Short description of the application for
workflow onboarding

options.name: --agent-goals
options.description:
Comma- or semicolon-separated workflows
the app agent should help users
accomplish

options.name: --save-config
options.description:
Save workflow onboarding intent to
.agentblazorc

options.name: --scan-scope
options.description:
Workflow analysis scan scope: references
or solution

options.name: --workflow
options.description:
Comma-separated workflow candidate ids or
slugs to apply in non-interactive mode

options.name: --apply-approved
options.description:
Apply workflows already marked approved
in .agentblazor/workflow-onboarding.json

options.name: --reject
options.description:
Comma-separated workflow candidate ids or
slugs to mark rejected in the review
artifact

options.name: --pin
options.description:
Comma-separated workflow candidate ids or
slugs to pin in the review artifact

options.name: --unpin
options.description:
Comma-separated workflow candidate ids or
slugs to unpin in the review artifact

options.name: --reviewed-by
options.description:
Reviewer identity to record in workflow
onboarding review artifacts

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Skip interactive prompts and use defaults

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
Path to solution/project, or 'workflows' for workflow
onboarding

arguments.name: WORKFLOW_PATH
arguments.description: Path to solution/project when using 'scaffold workflows'
